_readme: Per-model quirks the AI Proxy applies automatically. Each key (except _readme) is a model-name pattern matched against the post-routing model name. Fields: match = prefix|substring|exact (default substring); thinking = force_off (always disable reasoning) | default_off_optin (off unless reasoning_effort is high/medium) | normal (leave alone); notes = free text. This file is merged OVER the baked-in defaults (file wins per key) and hot-reloads on save — no restart needed. See GET /__proxy/api/model-quirks for the effective config.

ornith.system_nudge: Be concise and direct. Start immediately with the answer — the code, command, tool call, or the direct fact — with ZERO preamble (no "I'll...", "Let me...", "I need to...", "First,...", "I can see...", "The user wants..."). Give the minimal response that fully answers: do NOT add examples, alternative approaches, step-by-step breakdowns, caveats, or a closing summary unless explicitly asked. Prefer the shortest correct answer. If acting, emit the tool call directly with no narration.
ornith.notes: Qwen3.5-MoE / gated-delta-net. Ignores OpenAI reasoning_effort — thinking is only controllable via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking, and the template defaults to ON. On vLLM, requires --reasoning-parser qwen3 to split reasoning into the `reasoning` field (else it bleeds into `content`). Over-reasons and can return empty content when thinking is on with a tight max_tokens, so default OFF (bench-optimal for coding); reasoning_effort high/medium opts in. Even with thinking off it narrates reasoning in the content, so system_nudge curbs that (applied only when no-think).
